slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
fearlessly self assured

volunteering to go first

when a group needs someone to start, be the one who says i'll go. the nerves last thirty seconds, but people remember the person who stepped up for months.

giving credit out loud

publicly thank the person who did something well in every meeting this week. people who praise others easily look secure, and they're the ones others follow.

learning on coffee breaks

use one coffee break a day to learn something new in 5 minutes: a moment in history, a scientific idea. talking calmly about anything is real confidence.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning on coffee breaks

i use one coffee break a day to learn something new in 5 minutes. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and being able to talk about anything made me calm.

slides.texte_overlay:
the honest question

once a week, ask someone senior a genuine question about how they think, not about work. most people never dare to ask, and it quietly changes how they see you.

finishing early

say when you'll finish something, then finish it a little early without announcing it. every promise you keep quietly adds to the confidence you carry.
